scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix src install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run translations:pull && npm run translations:generate-index
scripts.build: npm --prefix src run build && npm --prefix web run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['.npm.installed','.yarn.installed']) fs.writeFileSync(f,'');"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix src run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.tsc: npm --prefix src run tsc && npm --prefix web run tsc
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n src,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix src run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.dev:ingame: npx concurrently -n src,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix src run dev:ingame" "npm --prefix web run dev:ingame"
scripts.dev:mobile: npx concurrently -n src,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix src run dev:mobile" "npm --prefix web run dev:mobile"
